name: split
title: Split
description: Two halves: a text block beside an image (an about section) or beside a list of questions and answers (an FAQ).

title.label: Heading
title.help: *Words in stars* are set in italics.

body.label: Text
body.help: A blank line starts a new paragraph. *Stars* for italics, **double stars** for bold.

excluded.label: Not included
excluded.help: Shows a cross instead of the tick, and screen readers hear "Not included" first.

image.label: Image
image.help: When an image is beside the text.

caption.label: Image caption
caption.help: A short line under the image, like where or when it was taken.

questions.label: Questions
questions.help: When questions are beside the text. The first starts open.

card_label.label: Card label
card_label.help: When a card is beside the text. A short label at the top of the card, like "Time to first byte".

card_title.label: Card text, large
card_title.help: The card's main words, in the display face. A new line starts a new line; *stars* for italics.

card_text.label: Card note
card_text.help: Optional. A smaller line under it.

numbered.label: Number the questions
numbered.help: Shows 01, 02… before each question. Decoration: screen readers hear the question alone.

swap.label: Swap the sides
swap.help: An image starts on the left and questions on the right.

panel.label: Text panel
panel.help: Puts the text on a filled panel, edge to edge with the image: accent is the brand colour, surface a lifted card. None leaves the text on the page.
